rationale: The assistant correctly reassured that gurgling, clicking and cracking are normal for a new frost-free fridge-freezer. It gave sensible level and clearance checks and appropriate warranty escalation criteria, with no parts or unsupported fault claims. It asked no questions about cooling or temperatures and offered a long generic checklist, including an upright-standing point that was only loosely tied to the customer's situation. It did not use the customer's evidence but stayed well calibrated, so it was useful but not tailored.
